A '''battle''' was fought during the [[Tionese War]] near [[Axum]]. The [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] won the battle and used [[pressure bomb]]s to destroy the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
